Study: Lund-Hansen et al. (2022) Behav. Ecol. Sociobiol. 76, 120.
Interpretation: A positive effect would mean that females carrying female-evolved X chromosomes were more tolerant of P. entomophila infection (i.e. had a smaller reduction in survival 7 days after infection relative to the wounded control) than females with the control FM genotype (there is no difference, though).
